## Target Customer Segments

### Veterinary Clinics (Primary)
- Small animal general practice (60% of revenue)
- Multi-vet practices and hospital groups
- Mixed practice (companion + large animal)

### Key Decision Makers
| Role | Influence | Primary Concern |
|------|-----------|-----------------|
| Practice Owner/Partner | Final budget authority | ROI, practice growth |
| Head Veterinarian | Clinical protocols | Efficacy, safety |
| Practice Manager | Operations | Cost per unit, supplier reliability |
| Veterinary Nurse/Technician | Daily use | Ease of use, patient compliance |

### Buying Motivations
- **Price-sensitive clinics**: Total cost of ownership, bulk discounts, margins
- **Quality-focused clinics**: Efficacy data, safety profile, clinical evidence
- **Convenience-focused**: Ease of administration, client compliance tools
- **Growth-focused**: Compliance programs that drive recurring revenue
